metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 3)
metadata.description: Partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers Hub aggregation, Verifier storage, Indexer service, and Decider-Prover service properties.

checklist.title: Verify Hub stores transfer root in correct token index slot
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT correctly maps incoming transfer roots to the appropriate token index derived from the source EID, preventing cross-token root corruption.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _lzReceive handler in Hub contract
2. Trace how tokenIndex is derived from source EID
3. Verify tokenIndex mapping is correctly configured per chain
4. Confirm transferRoots[tokenIndex] storage uses correct index
5. Test with multiple source EIDs to verify isolation

executable_checks.assertion: Root stored in correct slot per source EID
Each registered zERC20 has unique token index

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-041-ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT. CRITICAL: Incorrect token index could corrupt aggregation tree.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED implies storage complete
checklist.description: Verify that reaching STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED means the transferRoots[tokenIndex] storage variable has been updated atomically.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate RootUpdated event emission in Hub
2. Verify event is emitted after storage write
3. Confirm no early return paths bypass storage
4. Check that transaction atomicity ensures consistency
5. Verify no callback can interrupt storage-to-event flow
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-042-STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED. Storage update must be atomic with state transition.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST allows permissionless broadcast trigger
checklist.description: Verify that broadcast() is a public function that can be triggered by any caller once sufficient roots are collected, preventing broadcast censorship.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify broadcast() function visibility is public/external
2. Confirm no onlyOwner or access control modifier
3. Check that broadcast conditions are purely state-based
4. Verify gas cost is reasonable for any caller
5. Test broadcast from non-privileged address

executable_checks.assertion: Any address can trigger broadcast when conditions met
broadcast() has no access control modifiers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-043-STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST. Permissionless broadcast prevents operator censorship.

checklist.title: Verify Hub computes PoseidonT3 aggregation tree correctly
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION uses the correct PoseidonT3 hash function with proper tree structure for aggregating up to 64 token roots.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _computeAggregationRoot() in Hub
2. Verify PoseidonT3 library is used correctly
3. Confirm tree height is fixed at 6 (2^6 = 64 leaves)
4. Verify empty slots use zeros in hash computation
5. Cross-verify with off-chain aggregation implementation

executable_checks.assertion: On-chain and off-chain aggregation produce same root

executable_checks.command: Verify PoseidonT3 parameters match circuit parameters
executable_checks.assertion: Same parameters used on-chain and in ZK circuits

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-044-ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION -> Node ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION. CRITICAL: Aggregation tree must match circuit expectations.

checklist.title: Verify aggSeq monotonically increases without reset
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ only allows aggSeq to increase, with no decrement or reset functionality that could enable replay attacks.
detection_procedure: 1. Search Hub contract for all aggSeq references
2. Verify only aggSeq++ operation exists
3. Confirm no decrement (--) or assignment (=) operations
4. Check owner/admin cannot reset aggSeq
5. Verify upgrade patterns cannot reset aggSeq
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-045-ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ -> Node ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ. CRITICAL: Monotonicity prevents replay attacks.

checklist.title: Verify Hub broadcasts to all registered Verifiers
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT sends the aggregation root to every registered Verifier without omission.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate broadcast() function in Hub
2. Verify loop iterates over all verifierEids array
3. Confirm no early exit or skip conditions
4. Verify _lzSend is called for each EID
5. Check that failed sends revert entire transaction

executable_checks.assertion: LayerZero message sent to every registered Verifier

executable_checks.command: Review verifierEids array iteration in broadcast()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-046-ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT. All Verifiers must receive global root for protocol consistency.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST implies complete message delivery
checklist.description: Verify that reaching STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST means LayerZero messages have been atomically sent to all registered Verifiers.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify broadcast() transaction atomicity
2. Confirm any _lzSend failure reverts entire transaction
3. Check no try/catch swallows send failures
4. Verify event emission after all sends complete
5. Test partial failure scenario

executable_checks.assertion: Partial send failure reverts entire transaction

executable_checks.command: Review error handling in broadcast() loop
executable_checks.assertion: No error suppression in send loop

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-047-STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST. Atomic broadcast ensures global consistency.

checklist.title: Verify Verifier authenticates Hub before saving global root
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT validates the source EID matches the authorized Hub before storing any global root.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _lzReceive in Verifier contract
2. Verify source EID validation: require(srcEid == hubEid)
3. Confirm check occurs before any storage write
4. Verify hubEid cannot be changed by attacker
5. Test with spoofed source EID
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-048-ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT. CRITICAL: Hub authentication prevents fake root injection.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED implies correct storage
checklist.description: Verify that reaching STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED means globalTransferRoots[aggSeq] has been written with the received root.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate GlobalRootSaved event in Verifier
2. Verify event emission after storage write
3. Confirm storage uses correct aggSeq index
4. Verify no path bypasses storage before event
5. Test event data matches stored value

executable_checks.assertion: Event emitted after storage with correct data

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-049-STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED. Storage state must match event emission.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer availability monitoring exists
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-INDEXER-IDLE represents a properly monitored off-chain service ready to process events, with appropriate availability SLAs.
detection_procedure: 1. Review indexer service architecture documentation
2. Verify health check endpoints exist
3. Confirm monitoring and alerting is configured
4. Check redundancy/failover mechanisms
5. Review SLA commitments

executable_checks.assertion: Indexer responds to health checks within SLA

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-050-STATE-INDEXER-IDLE -> Node STATE-INDEXER-IDLE. Operational responsibility - service availability is not a security property.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer captures all IndexedTransfer events without loss
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS captures every IndexedTransfer event emitted on-chain, with retry logic for RPC failures.
detection_procedure: 1. Review event subscription implementation
2. Verify retry logic for failed RPC calls
3. Confirm persistent event cursor tracking
4. Check for block reorg handling
5. Verify event deduplication logic

executable_checks.command: Test event capture during RPC failure simulation
executable_checks.assertion: All events captured after RPC recovery

executable_checks.command: Review event subscription retry logic in indexer code

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-051-ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS. Operator responsibility - missing events cause proof failure, not security breach.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer Merkle tree matches on-chain computation
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE constructs a Merkle tree using the same algorithm and parameters as the on-chain hash chain.
detection_procedure: 1. Compare indexer hash algorithm with zERC20 hash chain
2. Verify same Poseidon parameters used
3. Confirm leaf ordering matches event order
4. Verify padding/empty leaf handling matches
5. Cross-verify tree root with on-chain transferRoot

executable_checks.command: Compare indexer tree root with on-chain transferRoot
executable_checks.assertion: Roots match for same set of transfers

executable_checks.command: Audit indexer hash implementation against on-chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-052-ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE. Tree mismatch causes proof rejection, self-correcting via on-chain verification.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY implies on-chain consistency
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY means the Merkle tree root computed by the indexer matches the on-chain transfer root.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify indexer performs root comparison before ready state
2. Confirm on-chain root query mechanism
3. Check finality requirements before comparison
4. Verify ready state triggers proof generation
5. Test inconsistency detection and recovery

executable_checks.command: Force tree inconsistency and verify detection
executable_checks.assertion: Indexer detects and reports root mismatch

executable_checks.command: Review tree ready state transition logic
executable_checks.assertion: Root comparison required before ready state

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-053-STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY -> Node STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY. Self-verifying via on-chain proof validation.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer generates valid Merkle inclusion proofs
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS provides Merkle proofs that pass on-chain verification in the ZK circuit.
detection_procedure: 1. Review Merkle proof generation algorithm
2. Verify proof format matches circuit expectations
3. Confirm sibling node ordering is correct
4. Test proof verification in circuit
5. Verify historical proof retrieval works

executable_checks.command: Generate proof and verify in circuit offline
Audit proof generation against circuit constraints
executable_checks.assertion: Proof format matches circuit input structure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-054-ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS. Invalid proofs caught by ZK circuit verification.

checklist.title: Verify Decider-Prover service availability monitoring
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-PROVER-IDLE represents a properly monitored decider-prover service ready for Nova-to-Groth16 conversion.
detection_procedure: 1. Review decider-prover deployment architecture
2. Verify health check endpoints exist
3. Confirm monitoring and alerting configured
4. Check capacity planning for proof conversion
5. Review fallback/self-hosted prover options

executable_checks.assertion: Prover responds to health checks within SLA

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-055-STATE-PROVER-IDLE -> Node STATE-PROVER-IDLE. Operational responsibility - users can self-host prover if service unavailable.

checklist.title: Verify Prover accepts IVC proofs from any user without censorship
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC accepts Nova IVC proofs from any user without identity-based filtering or censorship.
detection_procedure: 1. Review proof submission API
2. Verify no identity/address filtering
3. Confirm rate limiting is fair (not discriminatory)
4. Check terms of service for censorship policies
5. Document self-hosted prover option

executable_checks.command: Review proof submission endpoint for filtering logic

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-056-ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC -> Node ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC. Operator responsibility - users can run own prover.

checklist.title: Verify queued jobs are persisted and not lost
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-JOB-QUEUED implies the proof conversion job has been durably stored and will not be lost due to service restart.
detection_procedure: 1. Review job queue implementation
2. Verify durable storage (database/queue)
3. Confirm job persistence across restarts
4. Check job deduplication mechanism
5. Verify job expiration/cleanup policies

executable_checks.command: Submit job, restart service, verify job persists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-057-STATE-JOB-QUEUED -> Node STATE-JOB-QUEUED. Operational responsibility - job persistence is service quality.

checklist.title: Verify processing jobs have timeout and recovery
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-JOB-PROCESSING includes timeout handling to prevent jobs from being stuck indefinitely.
detection_procedure: 1. Review job processing timeout configuration
2. Verify stuck job detection mechanism
3. Confirm job retry or failure handling
4. Check resource cleanup on timeout
5. Verify user notification on job failure

executable_checks.command: Simulate stuck job and verify timeout triggers
executable_checks.assertion: Job times out and transitions to failed/retry

executable_checks.command: Review job timeout and recovery logic

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-058-STATE-JOB-PROCESSING -> Node STATE-JOB-PROCESSING. Operational responsibility - processing time is service quality.

checklist.title: Verify Nova-to-Groth16 conversion preserves proof semantics
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 produces valid Groth16 proofs that preserve the semantic meaning of the input Nova IVC proof.
detection_procedure: 1. Review Nova decider implementation (sonobe library)
2. Verify public inputs are preserved through conversion
3. Confirm Groth16 verification key matches circuit
4. Test converted proofs pass on-chain verification
5. Verify no proof forgery possible through conversion

executable_checks.command: Convert Nova proof and verify Groth16 on-chain

executable_checks.assertion: Public inputs correctly mapped through conversion

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-059-ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 -> Node ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16. CRITICAL: Conversion must preserve proof semantics for ZK soundness.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-JOB-COMPLETED implies valid Groth16 proof available
checklist.description: Verify that reaching STATE-JOB-COMPLETED means a valid Groth16 proof is stored and retrievable by the user.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify completion status set after proof storage
2. Confirm proof retrieval API returns valid proof
3. Check proof format matches on-chain expectations
4. Verify no completion without successful conversion
5. Test proof retrieval after completion
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-060-STATE-JOB-COMPLETED -> Node STATE-JOB-COMPLETED. Invalid proofs caught by on-chain verification.
